title: Roster
description: Roster: a human authors it; the dispatcher reads it. Precedence, lowest to highest: scripts/cmux/roster.default.json, then the user-level roster.json under ~/.claude/dev-team, then the project-level roster.json under <project>/.claude/dev-team, then a session override (RESERVED — no command exposes it yet). Frontmatter in agents/*.md is NOT a precedence layer in cmux mode; it stays authoritative for subagent/workflow mode and supplies the role-prompt body. Schema evolution: every file carries schema_version, starting at 1. A reader that encounters a schema_version higher than the one it knows REFUSES the document — it never best-efforts; the validator reports this as a distinctly named schema_version_too_new violation. Adding a value to an enum bumps schema_version if and only if some consumer branches on that enum with a documented default or else path. No bump: tools, profile.allow grants, permission_mode, isolation, agent, return.kind. Bump: outcome, level, escalate_to, postcondition. When in doubt, bump.

defaults.description: Deliberately no `model`: model is required on every role, which removes an either/or the keyword budget cannot express.

profiles.description: Keys are profile names. No `properties` node: this is an open-keyed map whose value shape is fixed by additionalProperties.

additionalProperties.description: Profile: `allow` holds agent-neutral capability tokens, never permission-rule strings — the builder owns every literal rule string. Tool-name denies and the tool set are invariants hoisted out of profiles. `postcondition_ignore` globs filter `git status --porcelain` output and are therefore repo-relative with no leading / and no .. segment. Deliberately absent, and their absence IS the enforcement: no `deny` key, no `tools` key, no `disable_slash_commands` key.

roles.description: Keys are role names. No `properties` node: this is an open-keyed map whose value shape is fixed by additionalProperties.

model.description: Validated against the shared MODEL_ALIASES whitelist or /^claude-/ by test, not by regex here.

schema.description: Plugin-root-relative filename. Required when kind is json.
